# Review — kebra-nagast-ch25-26 — Pass 1

Units are numbered from 0 (0 = ch. 25 heading, 17 = ch. 26 heading, 31 = last unit). `units.json` was edited in place by script; the joined `t` was checked after the edit and still equals the packet Geʿez. `gloss.json` not touched. Dillmann and all modern translations unavailable or unopened; judgments below rest on the form, the published parts (ch. 1–24) and conventions.md.

## Changes

### Major
1. U1 · n, l, i · major · ብዙኀ ክብረ was labelled a construct ("abundant of honor"). A noun after a construct stands bare, so ክብረ with -ä cannot be its genitive. Also, አምኃ was called "the plural of አምኃ", which is circular, and i said "worthy of honor, such as he would desire" while the note read ተፈቀደ as "fitting". · Note rewritten: ብዙኀ accusative "many", ክብረ a second accusative in apposition ("as honor"), the ዘ-clause belongs to ክብረ; አምኃ "gifts" (accusative); ተፈቀደ "needed/fitting" as in the glossary. l and i rebuilt ("gifts to-the-king, many, honor which is-needed for-him" / "gifts, many of them, as the honor that was fitting for him").
2. U20 · i, l, n · major · i dropped ያጠአጥእ altogether, dropped ሣእሣአ and repeated "the sweetness of your word" (so a word of the text was lost and another doubled); l and note called ሣእሣአ "sweetness" and "a repeat" though the next word is ጣዕመ ቃልከ; i rendered አዳም as "beauty" with no (?) though the note says "pleasantness (?)"; "[refreshes]" was bracketed as if transliteration; መከይደ left as [mäkäyd] though ch. 18 and ch. 24 render it "tread". · All of these fixed: every verb and noun of the text now has an equivalent in l and i; ሣእሣአ kept as [śaʾśaʾä] (?) as in ch. 22; አዳም "pleasantness (?)"; መከይደ "tread (?)"; note records the mixed nominative/accusative list and the ʾa-/ʾastä- stems.
3. U24 · l, i, n · major · l and i had "before my-lady" for ለእግዝእትየ (ለ- is "for", there is no ቅድመ); i began "mine is what the God of Israel gave me" (a possessive the text does not have: በዘ is "by that which", clause verbless); note called ሕጉ "the construct" (it is ሕግ + -ሁ, the genitive after ታቦተ), reasoned "ታቦት is feminine, so 'lady'" loosely, and gave ኣንሶሱ the wrong root (ነሰሰ). · l and i: "for my lady", "it is by what the God of Israel gave me"; note: ሕጉ "his law" with ለአምላከ እስራኤል naming whose, ኣንሶሱ from ነሶሰወ "walk about", verbless clause stated.

### Moderate
4. U7 · l, i, n · moderate · ታስተአድም rendered "admires, wonders" (guess); ch. 23 (published) reads the same verb "resolves, sets her mind (to go)", and in context (በኅሊናሃ "in her mind") that suits better. Note also called the stem an "ሰ-stem" (it is the አስተ- stem), and ታስተዐጽብ's note did not mention that ch. 23 read it "reckons hard". · l "sets-her-mind(?)", i "took thought (?)", note cross-refers ch. 22/23 and names the stem correctly.
5. U8 · i, n · moderate · i "for he was perfect … and in wisdom" turned ከመ "that" into "for" and ጠቢብ "wise" into "in wisdom". The note said the next unit begins a new list, but ወጠቢብ takes its በ-phrase there (ጠቢብ በኅሊና, like ፍሡሕ በጸጋ, ላሕይ በግርማ). · i "that he was perfect in beauty (?) and wise"; note explains the split.
6. U9 · i, n · moderate · i "Thoughtful in mind" (duplicating "wise" and splitting the pair above); "cheerful in his bearing" for በጸጋ "in grace"; note called the ሐ spelling "a copyist's variant" (unknown whether Bezold's or a manuscript's) and referred to "the earlier ሣእሣእ" without saying where. · i "in thought, and cheerful in grace, handsome in majesty"; note: "variant spelling", points to ch. 22 and ch. 26 below.
7. U10 · n · moderate · ኢምንት described as "something" with ኒ "for emphasis"; it is ኢ- + ምንት "nothing/anything at all", -ኒ "even". Also "construct of ብዝኀ" for ብዝኅ. · Corrected. l/i: [ntuga] respelled [nətugä] to match the mechanical reading.
8. U11 · l, i, n · moderate · መሳውር glossed "cords (?)" although ch. 17–20 (published, ወመሳውረ) left it unidentified; ይትጌበር called "reflexive-intensive" (the type is ተፋዕለ, with ጌ an odd spelling); መዳልው "scales" duplicated መኣዝን "scales" in U12. · መሳውር now [mäsawr] (?), note says why; ይትጌበር relabelled; መዳልው "balances" (U12 keeps "scales").
9. U12 · l, i, n · moderate · note listed መሳፍል as an unknown tool while l/i silently rendered it "measures"; i gave "gold" with no (?) though the note marks ነሀብት (?). · Note says it is read as a spelling of መሳፍር (ል for ር); i marks "measures (?)" and "gold (?)". Transliterations repaired (see 13).
10. U14 · l, n · moderate · l had no equivalent for እም- in እምቃለ and dropped ለ- of ለዓጋንንትኒ and the -ሙ of ቀነዮሙ; note ignored the ለ-. · l "from-the-voice-of", "and-as-for-the-demons-also he-subdued-them"; note explains partitive እም- and the fronted ለ-.
11. U19 · l, i, n · moderate · እምፈተውኩ rendered "I would rather", against the house rendering "if I wished" used twice in ch. 23 (the note there offers "rather" as the alternative). · Brought into line; the note keeps "rather" as the alternative.
12. U22 · i, n · moderate · the speech opened in U18 was never closed (house usage, ch. 24: closing quote at the end of the speech); the note did not account for the final -ቶ of ኣአኵቶ (object suffix -ኦ, taken up by ለዘ). · Closing quote added; note extended; l "I-thank-him".
13. U2–4, 10–12, 20 · l, i · moderate · bracketed transliterations of unidentified words were wrong against the signs: ጠቢቁ as "ṭabibu" (ቁ is qu), "[zabadw]", "[maṭabbəq]", "[tāʿka]" (macron foreign to the house style), "[ʿasəwar]", "[grät]", "[karami]", "[mazaryan]/[mazaryat]", "[ṣaqawwəʿa]", "[maʿanṭa]", "[mawāqər]", "[mag°anṭ]/[maguanṭ]" (ጵ is not ṭ), "[yamegab]", "[yaṭaʾṭəʾ]", "[adām]", "[ntuga]". · All respelled to agree with the mechanical reading of the build (e.g. [ṭäbiqu], [zäbadw], [mäṭabq], [taʿka], [ʿaswar], [gərät], [kärami], [mäzaryan], [ṣäqawʿä], [mäʿanṭä], [mäwaqr], [mägʷanp̣ət], [yəmegb], [yaṭäʾäṭʾ], [nətugä]).
14. U25 · l, i, n · moderate · ዘእትለአክ rendered "one who is sent … I do not go on errands" although U24 puts ተለአከ beside "stand" and "go about" as "serve"; the same verb thus had two senses in adjacent units. · "one-who-ministers(?)" / "I do not serve by my own will", note explains.
15. U26–30 · i · moderate (the five lines taken together; U28 also minor) · l gives perfects (ዘአንበበኒ "who made me speak", ዘአዘዘኒ "commanded", ዘሠርሐኒ, ዘመሀረኒ, ዘአጥበበኒ), i turned them into present tense ("has me speak", "commands", "sets", "teaches", "makes me wise"). · i now "is the one who made me speak … commanded me … set me on my way (?) … taught me … made me wise"; the (?) of ሠርሐ added to i of U28; note on U26 clarified (no copula; እነብብ the main verb).
16. U31 · l, i, n · moderate · note said "ትተፋእ 3fs agreeing with ምራቅ?" but እንተ and ትተፋእ are feminine and agree with ነጠብጣብ "drop"; ለሐኰኒ was given a root ለሐከ without noticing the ኰ, and i "formed me" lacked the (?) that the note has; "the word for the adamah-clay of Genesis 2:7" claims a Geʿez Bible wording nobody here has checked; the speech opened at U23 was never closed. · Note corrected; "formed (?)" in l and i; Genesis claim reduced to "compare Genesis 2:7"; closing quote added.
17. U16 · n · moderate · ከመ የሀቦ explained as "ከመ + ያሀብ"; the form is የሀብ (3ms subjunctive of ወሀበ) + -ኦ. "His house" was asserted to be the Temple, but the Temple is ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር in this part and ቤቶ may be Solomon's own house. · Both corrected in the note; i unchanged.

## Findings refused (checked, kept)

- U0 · ዘከመ as a heading ("How"), ኀበ "to" in the ch. 25 heading versus "Where" in the ch. 26 heading (ch. 23, 24 begin with ኀበ and are rendered "Where"): consistent with the published headings and with the known-form entry. Kept.
- U1 · "ወአብአት … causative of ቦአ": correct. U2 · ተፈሥሐ as a ተ-stem of ፈሥሐ: acceptable.
- U6 · ወይትናዘዝ "converses" (ተናዘዘ): the reciprocal sense is defensible and the note labels the stem; no better rendering can be checked without Dillmann. U7 · በኀቤሁ "in his presence/with him": the known-form entry lists both "from him" and "with him"; kept.
- U11 · "showed the workmen": the note says the workmen are understood; I judge the inference harmless and the note says so. U12 · ኬነት "craft": uncertain but flagged by context; kept.
- U13, U15, U21, U22–23: grammar labels checked against the forms (ተዐደወ, ሶበ + perfect, እሬእየከ, ባሕርይ "pearl", ጊሜ with (?), ወዘአኬደኒ, አኬደ, ሠረጸት agreeing with ጥበብ), no change needed. U22 · "made me come to the threshold" for አኬደ ("made me go"): sense acceptable in English.
- U24 · "ቀዋሚሃ ለደብተራሁ — pronoun anticipating the noun": the suffix -ሃ agrees with fem. ደብተራ and -ሁ is God's; the draft's reading stands. U24 · ትርዓዪ "so that you can look upon me": ambiguous, left.
- U31 · "though I was earth" for እንዘ ("while"): the concessive sense is listed in the glossary (ch. 16) and fits; kept. ርጉዐ "curdled" and the Job 10:10 echo: kept as the note's stated echo only.
- Scriptural references (1 Kings 10:4–8, 3:5–14, 4:29; 1 Chron. 28:11–19; Prov. 1:7, 16:24; Ps. 51:8, 111:10, 119:105; Song 4:3, 13; 1 Sam. 25:41; Gen. 1:26, 2:7; Job 10:10; Heb. 8:5; Ex. 25:40; Rev. 22:16; Isa. 14:12; Matt. as cited): all plausible; no wrong citation found.

- Check that new entries give the dictionary lemma, not the surface form, for: ወአብአት (አብአ), ዘየሀይድ (root uncertain), ወይትጌበር (ተጋብረ/ገብረ), ኣንሶሱ (ነሶሰወ), ኣአኵቶ (አአኰተ + -ኦ), ዘአሥረጽኪ (አሥረጸ), ኢታአምሪ (አእመረ), ዓውሥአ (አውሥአ), ወዘአኬደኒ (አኬደ), ዘእትለአክ (ተለአከ), ለሐኰኒ (uncertain), ትተፋእ (ተፍአ), ወትየብስ (የብሰ), ኢምንትኒ (ኢምንት + ኒ).

## Counts
Major 3 · moderate 14 · minor 7 (24 numbered changes; several span more than one unit).

# Pass 2

Re-read all 32 units against the packet and every one of the 260 `gloss.json` entries against the text, the 109 known entries, the published parts (ch. 1–24) and conventions.md. `units.json` and `gloss.json` were edited in place by script; the joined `t` still equals the packet Geʿez, every novel form still has a key, and every `__broaden__` key is a known form whose old entry is copied whole. No Dillmann and no modern translation was opened. Units were re-checked for fresh errors, l ↔ i, and the labels in the notes; the pass-1 corrections held, apart from the three note slips below.

## Changes

### units.json
1. U5 · n · minor · "ወለለ ዕለት … (ለ- + ለ 'each')" contradicted the note on U3 (corrected in pass 1), which says ለለ is itself the distributive, and the known entry ወለለ (ወ- + ለለ). · Now ወ- + ለለ.
2. U22 · n · moderate · the verb of ኣአኵቶ was named አአኰተ, a form that exists nowhere (the gloss and the dictionary form is አኰተ; ኣ- is the 1cs prefix). · Note now says አኰተ and that ኣ- is the prefix.
3. U23 · n · minor · "ጥበብሰ 'wisdom, as for her'" mis-glossed the -ሰ (it marks wisdom as the topic; there is no 'her'). · "as for wisdom".

### gloss.json, new entries
